notes: `probe_direct_stream_url` sends only `bytes=0-0` and accepts any 2xx; the URL is then cached. Playback later requests 1 MiB, validates `206`/`Content-Range`, and returns 502 on failure without trying the next resolver strategy. The fallback test explicitly expects only `bytes=0-0`, so the task’s no-502 playback contract lacks this regression coverage.
